api_ablation.baseline: Restore committed old intent method, General system prompt and General skill in an otherwise current runtime.
api_ablation.goal_only: Current intent method; restore old General system prompt and skill.
api_ablation.full: Current goal, General prompt and General skill.
semantic_acceptance: Use retrieved sources for known policy; state missing cancellation/after-dispatch policy explicitly.
No invented buttons, interception/rejection rules or after-dispatch eligibility.
Explain lookup methods without claiming a live result.
Unclear request clarifies; explicit case keeps materials and confirmation; refund status does not collect unusable fields.

stop: Five paired intent rounds and one eight-case API ablation per group; retain failures and do not retune these samples after results.
